info.title: MULTIGAME API
info.description: Generated from runtime Zod request contracts. Private quizzes, server-authoritative sessions, durable receipts, and explicit unavailable commercial integrations. Standard response envelope: {data,meta}; error envelope: {error}. Polling is always available; Node also provides scoped Socket.IO events.

Round.description: Creator-only full round configuration. secretConfig is never included in player/display snapshots.

pin.description: Present only for the authenticated host.

reveal.description: Only included once the host has revealed this round; completed and aborted views preserve an already published reveal.

CreatorCookie.name: __Host-mg_host
CreatorCookie.description: Node production cookie; development uses mg_host. Sites obtains creator identity through its verified server adapter instead.

ParticipantCookie.name: mg_player_<sessionId>
ParticipantCookie.description: Actual name substitutes the UUID of the session. HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure on HTTPS; digest stored in SQL, seven-day expiry.

DisplayToken.name: displayToken
DisplayToken.description: Expiring 256-bit read-only pairing credential; revoked independently by the host.
